hooks.command: input=$(cat); path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.path'); branch=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.branch'); git worktree add "$path" -b "$branch" 2>/dev/null || git worktree add "$path" "$branch"
path=$(jq -r '.path'); git worktree remove --force "$path" 2>/dev/null || rm -rf "$path"; git worktree prune 2>/dev/null || true
